act.name: Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006
act.source_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
act.description: Central law preventing child marriage and providing annulment, maintenance, custody, injunction and enforcement remedies.

sections.title: Marriage of a minor child to be void in certain circumstances.
sections.text: Section 12 makes a minor child's marriage void in the specified coercive or exploitative circumstances.
sections.plain_language_summary: A minor's marriage is void where the child was taken or enticed from a guardian, compelled by force, or sold or trafficked for marriage.
